theme_and_archetype.description: Cargo Manifest / Freight Document / Shipping Bill of Lading aesthetic. Sharp geometry, mono typography, ruled lines, and customs stamps to feel like a physical, secure shipping document.

rules.h1: font-display text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter text-[#14213D] font-bold
rules.h2: font-display text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#14213D] font-semibold
rules.eyebrow_labels: font-data text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#14213D] font-semibold

backgrounds.ruled_lines: Add to main container: `bg-[linear-gradient(transparent_31px,#C8D1DA_32px)] bg-[size:100%_32px] bg-[#E9EDF1]` to simulate a notebook/manifest paper.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Grid-based, rigid, industrial. Clear dividing lines between sections, no soft shadows.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border-[#14213D] everywhere. Cards should have no border radius (`rounded-none`).
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Hard offset shadows: `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#14213D]` for cards, buttons, modals.

components.button_primary: bg-[#14213D] text-white font-data uppercase tracking-widest text-sm px-6 py-3 border border-[#14213D] hover:bg-[#E8590C] hover:border-[#E8590C] transition-colors rounded-none shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#14213D] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#E8590C] active:translate-y-[2px] active:translate-x-[2px] active:shadow-none
components.button_secondary: bg-[#FFFFFF] text-[#14213D] font-data uppercase tracking-widest text-sm px-6 py-3 border border-[#14213D] hover:bg-[#E9EDF1] transition-colors rounded-none shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#14213D] active:translate-y-[2px] active:translate-x-[2px] active:shadow-none
components.card: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#14213D] rounded-none p-6 md:p-8 relative shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#14213D]
components.card_manifest_header: Every card must have 'Manifest No. 00X' printed in the top right using `font-data text-xs text-[#14213D]/50`.
components.customs_stamp: A div with `border-2 border-[#1F7A4D] text-[#1F7A4D] font-data uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1 inline-block rotate-[-12deg] opacity-90 font-bold rounded-sm`. Use for '★ CLEARED FOR IMPORT' or 'PRIVACY VERIFIED'.
components.inputs: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-[#14213D] border-t-0 border-l-0 border-r-0 rounded-none px-0 py-2 font-data focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#E8590C] transition-colors
components.table_list: List of files/conversations must look like a shipping ledger. Use `border-b border-[#C8D1DA]` for rows, monospace for sizes/dates, and checkboxes with sharp square borders.

motion.rules: No bouncy/spring physics. Use fast, mechanical transitions (`duration-150 ease-linear`). Snappy and deterministic like hardware.
motion.page_load: Fade in with a slight vertical slide (10px) using framer-motion `ease: 'circOut'`.

icons_and_assets.style: Regular or Bold weights, never Duotone or Fill. Industrial, literal icons (Package, FileText, CheckSquare, Stamp, ShieldCheck).

images.description: Stacked shipping containers. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for the hero section or 'Full Plan' upgrade modal, with a heavy #14213D overlay to maintain text readability.

landing_page.hero: H1 strictly left-aligned. A prominent 'PRIVACY VERIFIED' customs stamp positioned absolutely over the top right of the hero text block. Prominent primary CTA 'Start Migration Tool'.
landing_page.how_it_works: 3-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`). Each step numbered sequentially '01', '02', '03' in massive `text-6xl font-data text-[#14213D]/20`. Borders between columns on desktop.
landing_page.pricing: Two side-by-side cards. The 'Full Plan' card has an `#E8590C` border-top-4 and an 'APPROVED' customs stamp.
landing_page.footer: Massive top border `border-t-4 border-[#14213D]`. Heavy monospace branding.

app_tool.dropzone: Dashed border (`border-2 border-dashed border-[#14213D]/50 bg-[#E9EDF1] hover:border-[#E8590C] hover:bg-[#FFFFFF]`) taking up the main view. Icon: Phosphor 'FileArchive' size 64.
app_tool.manifest_review: Ledger-style table. Columns for 'Project Name' (editable input), 'Conversations', 'Size', 'Action'. Heavy use of IBM Plex Mono. Rows have hover effects.
app_tool.header: Sticky nav. Left: Logo. Right: Plan Pill (Free/Full) mapped to `bg-[#14213D] text-white` vs `bg-[#E8590C] text-white`. 'Upgrade' button uses secondary button styling if free.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text colors specified strictly meet WCAG AAA contrast due to dark ink on light paper.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts in index.html or import in CSS: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono, Inter.
Configure Tailwind spacing and colors to match the variables provided (ink, accent, stamp, paper, card, line).
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for landing page structural components; use Shadcn strictly for interactive logic (Dialogs, Checkboxes).
Shadcn customization: Strip all `rounded-md` and soft shadows from default Shadcn styles. Replace with `rounded-none`, `border-[#14213D]`, and hard `#14213D` offset shadows.
Implement the `bg-ruled-lines` utility class in index.css as specified.
Ensure the privacy promise is visually prominent near all file upload/dropzone areas.
